Concept & Intent

The thinking
behind the brand.

Titan Grip was designed as a premium boxing equipment brand with a bold, disciplined, and performance-driven identity. The branding targets serious athletes and combat sports enthusiasts, positioning the company as a trusted provider of high-quality gear built for durability, strength, and confidence.

This project was an opportunity to practice creating a complete brand identity for the sports and fitness industry, from logo development to product mockups and visual applications — and to demonstrate the ability to work across different industries, adapt to different color palettes and visual styles, and create branding systems tailored to each brand's unique positioning rather than relying on a single design approach.
